abstract: Maintains shore crossing planning consents and nearshore trenching distance data
system_message:
You are the nearshore landfall civil engineer (NSW), responsible for maintaining shore crossing planning consents and nearshore trenching distance data, as well as tracking landfall spoil disposal volumes across candidate corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Landfall spoil disposal（DREDGE）
information_points.content:
NSW-DREDGE-T9X：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, the trench spoil backfill volume of dredged sand backfilled over the cable protective conduit across the nearshore trench excavated materials is 11,000 m3.
NSW-DREDGE-7SG：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, the trench spoil backfill volume of dredged sand backfilled over the cable protective conduit across the nearshore trench excavated materials is 6,000 m3.
NSW-DREDGE-XUX：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, the trench spoil backfill volume of dredged sand backfilled over the cable protective conduit across the nearshore trench excavated materials is 8,500 m3.

information_points.title: Maintains shore crossing planning consents and nearshore trenching distance data（SHORE）
information_points.content:
NSW-SHORE-M7X：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, statutory municipal landfall planning consent has been granted for the terrestrial landfall and intertidal cable landing duct, and the nearshore jet-trenching distance from the landfall boundary to the 30 m bathymetric contour is 20 km.
NSW-SHORE-QGM：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, statutory municipal landfall planning consent has been granted for the terrestrial landfall and intertidal cable landing duct, and the nearshore jet-trenching distance from the landfall boundary to the 30 m bathymetric contour is 20 km.
NSW-SHORE-QID：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, statutory municipal landfall planning consent has not been granted for the terrestrial landfall and intertidal cable landing duct, while the nearshore jet-trenching distance from the landfall boundary to the 30 m bathymetric contour is 20 km.
